verdict.rationale: Proa is a self-hosted Rust web framework, and a privacy question about AI-training use of data is still a fair one for its ecosystem: its CLI, hosted docs, or a feature that keeps site content away from AI crawlers could plausibly address it. Nothing in the evidence pack covers data-use policy, training opt-out, telemetry controls, or AI-crawler blocking. The security-header and agent-docs features are adjacent topics and earn no credit here.
